title: Web Developer
subtitle: Job summary
body:
# Job summary

We are seeking an experienced and creative Web Developer to join our dynamic and fast-growing team. The ideal candidate will have strong programming skills, a deep understanding of modern web development principles and trends, and a passion for creating engaging and effective websites and web applications.

# Essential Roles and Responsibilities:

- Design, create, and maintain high-quality, responsive front-end functionalities for our platform (Shopify apps)

- Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code, adhering to best practices and coding standards.

- Collaborate closely with the Marketing Departments to understand requirements and convert them into technological implementations.

- Test and debug code to ensure websites and web applications function smoothly and are free of bugs.

- Keep websites and web applications up-to-date with the latest technologies and trends.

- Provide support and troubleshooting for existing websites and web applications.

- Implement iterative development practices, continuously delivering improvements and new functionalities.

- Contribute to new web development initiatives and improve existing processes.

# Skills and Qualifications:

- Have more than 2 years experience in the relevant position.

- Fluent in English communication (Writing and Reading).

- Experience with HTML, JavaScript, Python, Liquid (Shopify),...

- Understanding HTTP, CSS, API,... format.

- Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills with team members.

- Proactive learning behavior. We request all people to learn daily (only learn things that can support your work immediately) and share it with others.

- A positive, “can do” attitude.

# Come join PATI, you will have a chance to enjoy

- Salary: 15.000.000 VND/month + incentive based on performance (negotiate).

- Opportunity to work in a fast-growing E-commerce business.

- A Dynamic, Professional and Friendly Working Environment with the purpose of connecting people.

- To fully enjoy other social welfare regimes such as: social insurance, statutory leave,...

- Joining various team bonding activities.

Company Address: 152 Dien Bien Phu Street, Ward 25, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh city

**🚀 APPLY [HERE](https://paticreativeagency.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrusjCC2CJeEWBc1wNKIX7fibc)**
